visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are standing on a paved path surrounded by a dense green forest. The central figure is an Asian man wearing a black jacket and a bright red knitted beanie, gesturing with open arms. To his left and right are two muscular Black men wearing white tank tops and black arm sleeves. Colorful digital confetti sparkles across the frame at the beginning. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the ground where two large felled tree trunks lie next to a bright orange chainsaw and a traditional axe. Yellow text labels the logs. (3) The scene shifts to a group of four men in the forest, now wearing professional orange safety shirts and helmets with mesh face shields. They are examining a vertical tree stump; one man points toward the growth rings. The lighting is natural but diffused by the thick canopy. (4) The group is seen on a misty, deforested mountain slope. The background shows layered hills fading into the fog. They are engaged in conversation, smiling and laughing while holding logging equipment. (5) A final title card appears with large white and black brush-stroke text against a background of the men laughing in the forest. Informational text and a YouTube channel logo are visible at the bottom.
